senses.sense_definition: Op een speelse manier laten merken dat je iemand leuk of aantrekkelijk vindt.

examples.text: Zij stond de hele avond gezellig te <w>sjansen</w> met de barman.

target_lang_translations.en: She spent the whole evening happily <w>flirting</w> with the bartender.

examples.text: Ik zag hem gisteren uitgebreid <w>sjansen</w> met zijn nieuwe collega.

target_lang_translations.en: I saw him <w>flirting</w> extensively with his new colleague yesterday.

traits.comment: Commonly used in informal spoken Dutch.

target_lang_definitions.en: To playfully show that you find someone attractive or like them.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to behave as though attracted to someone, but playfully rather than with serious intentions
